title: LCD 16x2 — Hello World
summary: Show two lines of text on a 16x2 HD44780 LCD in 4-bit mode.
learningObjectives: Wire an HD44780 LCD in 4-bit mode.
Position the cursor and print text.
wiringChecklist: RS to D12, E to D11.
VSS/RW/K to GND; VDD/A to 5V; VO to the contrast model.
predictPrompt: Which pins carry the 4-bit data nibbles?
observePrompt: Run the sketch. Do both lines appear correctly?
tryNext: Print millis()/1000 on the second row and watch it count.
